messages:
Maya: quick thread 11 we need final microcopy for the launch pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). priority: hero headline, 1-line benefit, single-sentence panel blurb, and 2 CTA variants for A/B testing. keep language pragmatic and engineering-friendly.
Owen: agreed. layout idea: hero + tri-panel below + single benchmark callout + webinar signup module.
Priya: proposed hero hooks:
- Hosted hero: 'Ship LLM features fast' (alt: 'Start building — no infra headaches')
- Dedicated hero: 'Predictable throughput. SLA-backed.' (alt: 'Reserved capacity for production')
- Private hero: 'Inference behind your network' (alt: 'Private deployment, enterprise controls')
Ethan: single-sentence benefits (for panels)
- Hosted: 'Hosted API with curated models that get you from prototype to live without ops.'
- Dedicated: 'Reserved GPU pools tuned for consistent latency and predictable cost.'
- Private: 'Deploy the runtime in your VPC or on-prem for compliance and data control.'
Zoe: CTA short forms (primary / secondary):
- Hosted: Primary 'Start free trial', Secondary 'See benchmarks'
- Dedicated: Primary 'Book capacity consult', Secondary 'Read case study'
- Private: Primary 'Request private demo', Secondary 'Compliance FAQ'
Maya: excellent. for launch posts/social we want micro-copies tied to each mode: 1 sentence + 2 bullets (what it solves, who it's for). keep bullets tweet-length.
Priya: draft social blurbs:
- Hosted: 'New Hosted API: get integrations live in hours. Great for builders shipping prototypes and early product experiments.'
- Dedicated: 'Dedicated capacity for predictable production workloads. Ideal for mid-market and platform teams needing SLAs.'
- Private: 'Private deployment with KMS & audit logs. For regulated industries and security-first teams.'
Owen: webinar framing: 30min with live Q&A. title candidates: 'Production inference: benchmarks & migration playbook' (short) vs 'Serving LLMs in production: benchmarks, tradeoffs, and migration playbook' (long). use long in post copy, short in hero.
Ethan: benchmark callout copy idea: 'Benchmarks: latency vs cost tradeoffs across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. See sample p99 and cost-per-1k-tokens.' (avoid specific numbers on public page until validated)
Zoe: inbound routing rules proposal (form + tagging):
1) Single capture form with dropdown 'Deployment goal' -> Hosted / Dedicated / Private.
2) Hidden field utm_mode = Hosted|Dedicated|Private set by the form.
3) If user selects Dedicated or Private -> lead_tier = 'high_touch' and assign AE. Hosted -> lead_tier = 'self_serve'.
Owen: ops payload example for webhook to CRM (engineering will use):
```
email={{email}}&company={{company}}&deployment_goal={{deployment_goal}}&lead_tier={{lead_tier}}&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&share_benchmarks={{share_benchmarks}}
```
Priya: add a checkbox 'Share benchmark data and webinar invites' to opt users into follow-ups. make it unchecked by default.
Maya: A/B testing plan: test hero headline (short vs descriptive) + primary CTA text (trial vs consult) across modes. run for 2 weeks post-launch then pick winners.
Ethan: content ops note: avoid 'own the model' phrasing. prefer 'control over serving' or 'control over inference' per legal guidance.
Zoe: micro-case examples for panels (one-liners):
- Hosted micro-case: 'Product team launched chat feature in 2 days using Hosted API and pre-built SDKs.'
- Dedicated micro-case: 'Streaming app maintained 99th percentile latency targets during a holiday spike with Dedicated pools.'
- Private micro-case: 'Finance org deployed inference in a VPC with HSM-managed keys and audit logs for compliance.'
Owen: webinar nurture sequence outline: 3 emails -> 1) confirmation + what to expect, 2) reminder + highlight benchmark teaser, 3) day-of + join link + CTO note. capture questions ahead of time via form.
Priya: page microcopy samples (panels) ready for design handoff. I'll drop them in the design doc after this thread.
Maya: ops-bot: can you confirm mapping to Pardot/CRM?
ops-bot: Automation note: mapping fields to CRM: email -> contacts.email, company -> accounts.name, deployment_goal -> custom.deployment_mode, lead_tier -> custom.lead_tier. High-touch leads flagged for AE assignment.
Zoe: perf note for engineering: add utm_source for social posts like '?utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_content=dedicated_post' so we can split acquisition.
Maya: next steps: Priya finalizes copy, Zoe finalizes CTAs and form UX, Owen schedules social cadence, Ethan drafts webinar outline + slides, ops-bot to implement webhook mapping. reconvene in this thread with assets before content review. :rocket: 
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: content review in 24h.
Maya: thanks all, ping me if you hit blockers.
